functions.name: eye_sink_c_impl::eye_sink_c_impl
functions.signature:
eye_sink_c_impl::eye_sink_c_impl(int size,
                                 double samp_rate,
                                 unsigned int nconnections,
                                 QWidget* parent): sync_block("eye_sink_c",
                 io_signature::make(0, nconnections, sizeof(gr_complex)),
                 io_signature::make(0, 0, 0)),
      d_size(size),
      d_buffer_size(2 * size),
      d_samp_rate(samp_rate),
      d_nconnections(2 * nconnections),
      d_tag_key(pmt::mp("tags")),
      d_parent(parent)
